exposure: MRI-based classification systems for adenomyosis severity (specifically Kobayashi H classification)
cohort: Patients with adenomyosis from the Affiliated Nanchong Central Hospital of North Sichuan Medical College included between June 2017 and December 2021, all before focused ultrasound ablation surgery (FUAS).
finding: MRI-based Kobayashi H classification 4, considering affected areas and lesion volumes, was identified as the optimal classification for informing the severity of adenomyosis (dysmenorrhea and menorrhagia), with the phenotype of the classification being the main characteristic associated with disease severity.
